2610.13889.title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
2610.13889.paper_summary: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.
2610.13889.paper_summary_zh: 隨著 AI 代理越來越依賴外部工具，準確的檢索對於可靠的行為至關重要。現有的方法優化語義相關性，但在執行過程中大多忽略了工具的可用性。為了解決這一問題，我們提出了 RATED（基於執行動態的可靠性感知工具檢索），這是一個檢索框架，結合了穩健的語義匹配和動態的可靠性適應。RATED 使用一個凍結的雙編碼器，通過對比微調進行語義匹配，並且採用一個輕量級的上下文賭徒模塊，根據實時執行反饋重新排序候選者。這一設計使得能夠快速適應運行時工具故障，而無需昂貴的模型再訓練。我們引入了 EcoAgent，這是一個包含 5,172 個真實世界工具和超過 210,000 個查詢-工具對的基準，用於離線檢索和動態可靠性評估。實驗結果表明，RATED 在真實世界查詢上相對於 ToolLLM API 檢索器實現了 52.2% 的 MRR 改進，並且在嚴重的 API 中斷情況下故障選擇率從 86.2% 降低到 2.9%，同時在僅編碼推斷的情況下，延遲開銷不足 1 毫秒。代碼和數據集可在 https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent 獲得。
